basics.name: Cassio Cardoso
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience in front-end and full-stack development, and over 4 years of experience leading cross-functional teams. Proven track record in building scalable platforms, mentoring other engineers, and delivering innovative solutions to increase business outcomes.

work.name: Photoroom
work.description: Photoroom is an AI-powered photo editing platform that helps businesses create professional product images.

work.name: OLX Group
work.description: OLX Group is a global online marketplace operating in 30+ countries, connecting millions of buyers and sellers.
work.summary: Worked as a senior software engineer in the customer acquisition group focused on maintaining, improving, and developing new features for the home and listing pages of the application.
highlights: Worked in the customer acquisition group to maintain, improve, and develop new features for the home and listing pages
Implemented a plan to test a new frontend architecture for the listing page aiming to reduce the effort to maintain the page and develop new features

work.name: Oliva Health
work.description: Oliva Health is a mental health platform that connects employees with therapists and coaches to improve wellbeing in the workplace.
work.summary: 2nd engineer hired. Developed the whole platform from scratch by defining and implementing the main flows, making architectural decisions and creating the initial infrastructure. Managed a team of 4 full-stack engineers.
highlights: 2nd engineer hired; developed the whole platform from scratch by defining and implementing the main flows, making architectural decisions and creating the initial infrastructure
Managed a team of 4 full-stack engineers to successfully plan, design, and deliver product features on the backend, web and mobile
Developed a rule-based matching algorithm to match users and therapists which achieved a 95% success rate
Led the implementation of the SSO integration which generated over 200k ARR
Led the implementation of the first AI-powered feature that increased NPS from ~50 to 70

work.name: Vimcar
work.description: Vimcar creates products that revolutionize an entire industry. With future-oriented technology and great attention to detail, we are digitizing the company car of the future.
work.summary: Worked in the internal tooling team developing new tools for internal stakeholders and defining front-end development standards across the company.
highlights: Developed new tools for internal stakeholders and maintained existing ones (unified auth flow/app)
Defined standards for front-end development across the company (common patterns; shared libraries; design system)

work.name: Omio
work.description: Omio is a travel platform that allows users to find the fastest, cheapest and best travel options by train, bus and flight across Europe, the United States and Canada.
work.summary: Worked in the acquisition tribe where the main goal was to get more users on the platform and convert them into customers by providing the best experience tailored to their intent.
highlights: Used and maintained an internal framework to compose micro-frontends
Developed an MVP of the AMP project
Worked on defining, implementing, and measuring the landing page performance with lab and field data
Led the development of the Omio Magazine
Developed a recommendation solution that generated a 3% booking increase

work.name: QuintoAndar
work.description: QuintoAndar uses technology and design to make the renting experience pleasant for both tenants and landlords.
work.summary: Worked in the real estate agents support squad developing a new PWA and RESTful APIs integrated with Google Cloud services.
highlights: Built a new PWA for the real estate agents and developed RESTful APIs, micro-services and integrated with Google Cloud Firestore and third-party tools (Google Tag Manager; Sentry; Intercom)
Created and maintained a performance budget for the app (achieved a 5% improvement in loading time)

work.name: AMARO
work.description: AMARO is a digital native vertical brand (DNVB) that uses technology to deliver omni-channel retail experiences in Brazil.
work.summary: 1st engineer hired. Led the development of the in-house e-commerce platform from the ground up and managed the frontend engineering team.
highlights: 1st engineer hired; delivered the first in-house e-commerce platform, supporting 4M users/month and generating >$500k annual revenue
Led the migration of the platform into a more modern codebase using a React-based stack
Managed a team of frontend engineers through regular 1:1 meetings and feedback sessions
Actively involved in the hiring process, onboarding, and mentoring of new engineers

work.name: INPE
work.description: INPE is the Brazilian Institute for Space Research, which produces science and technology in the space areas and the terrestrial environment.
work.summary: Worked as a web developer in the space weather program, developed its web portal and several integrations with equipments collecting data across the country.
highlights: Developed the website for the Space Weather program
Developed systems to store and visualize data collected by different equipments across the country
Built an online system to allow space weather researchers to publish a daily bulletin
Built hot-sites for biannual workshops organized by the Space Weather program

volunteer.summary: Taubaté Big Donkeys is a non-profit sports organization based in Taubaté, São Paulo. The organization has an adult male flag-football team which plays the state championship in two modalities: 5x5 and 8x8. It had a junior and a female team during 2011-2013. It is always organizing events to help other NPOs in the city and increase awareness about football.
highlights: Managed the administrative and finance departments of the organization from 2011 to 2013.
Coached the adult team from 2010 to 2014.
Coached the junior and female team in 2013.
Organized around 4 football games in Taubaté city form 2011 to 2014.
Champion of Paraíba Valley Bowl in 2012
Runner up of Paraíba Valley Bowl in 2013
Third place in brazilian national flag championship in 2013
Runner-up of São Paulo state flag championship in 2013
Runner-up of São Paulo state flag championship in 2014

education.institution: UNIVAP - Universidade do Vale do Paraíba

projects.organization: FEMUG-VP (Front-end meetup group - Vale do Paraíba)
projects.summary: I helped to organize the Front-End developers community in Vale do Paraíba. Contacted BrazilJS, to open a new group in the region and merged the idea with other professionals with an existing group.
highlights: We organize monthly meetups to talk about front-end development, resources, worklfow, techniques and everything between these topics.

references.reference: Orientei o Cássio como bolsista-PCI no INPE durante o desenvolvimento do portal do programa EMBRACE - Estudo e Monitoramento Brasileiro de Clima Espacial. Desempenhou as atividades atribuídas a ele com competência e criatividade, sendo seu trabalho neste projeto considerado um dos melhores sob o programa PCI do INPE.
